specs.title: [P2P] The variance desk boots with its queue, reconciliation sheet, and decisions.
[P2P] A fresh desk shows all six cases and selects CC-104.
[P2P] Selecting an unfiltered case updates the reconciliation workspace.
[P2P] The adjacent-bin case visibly carries equal and opposite row variances.
[P2P] A large unresolved loss cannot be adjusted without another count.
[P2P] HOLD marks the selected case without changing its quantities.
[P2P] Invalid recount input leaves the current count history unchanged.
[P2P] Serial scanning is unavailable for ordinary inventory.
[F2P][D1] The second count is the authoritative total for CC-207.
[F2P][D1] CC-207 variance is derived from its second count.
[F2P][D1] Posting 49 makes it the latest count immediately.
[F2P][D1] Only the last of two new recounts is authoritative.
[F2P][D1] A posted recount and its latest total survive refresh.
[F2P][D1] UNDO removes the newest recount and restores the prior authoritative count.
[F2P][D2] Inbound units are included in Available for CC-509.
[F2P][D2] Inbound units are excluded from the physical variance for CC-509.
[F2P][D2] A recount of 14 changes variance but not the Available total.
[F2P][D3] LINK TRANSPOSE is available for the adjacent equal-and-opposite pair.
[F2P][D3] Linking the adjacent exchange resolves CC-104.
[F2P][D3] The linked decision identifies CC-104 without changing stock totals.
[F2P][D3] A linked transposition remains resolved after refresh.
[F2P][D3] UNDO restores a linked pair to its complete open state.
[F2P][D3] A pair can be linked again after undo and remains durable.
[F2P][D4] The exact five-unit CC-421 boundary is adjustable.
[F2P][D4] Adjusting the exact boundary resolves CC-421.
[F2P][D4] Boundary adjustment updates on-hand stock and clears variance.
[F2P][D4] The boundary adjustment survives refresh with its decision.
[F2P][D4] Recounting the large loss to the boundary enables adjustment.
[F2P][D5] Serialized shortage cannot adjust before its missing serial is scanned.
[F2P][D5] Serialized shortage initially reports zero of one required scans.
[F2P][D5] Scanning the missing serial completes the evidence coverage.
[F2P][D5] A fully evidenced serialized adjustment resolves the case.
[F2P][D5] Serialized evidence and adjustment survive refresh.
[F2P][D6] Applying SERIALIZED does not replace selected case CC-509.
[F2P][D6] Applying OPEN does not replace selected case CC-421.
[F2P][D6] Applying ALL does not replace selected case CC-318.
[F2P][D6] Repeated filter changes leave the reviewed case and evidence unchanged.
[F2P][D7] HOLD remains attached to the selected case after refresh.
[F2P][D7] UNDO after HOLD restores the complete open case.
[F2P][D7] UNDO after adjustment restores stock, count history, and status together.
[F2P][D7] Boundary recount, adjustment, and undo preserve the recount but restore stock.
[F2P][D8] Expected and counted AX-14 rows share one horizontal register.
[F2P][D8] Expected and counted BZ-22 rows share one horizontal register.
[F2P][D9] The reconciliation sheet remains contained at phone width.
[F2P][D9] The inventory summary remains contained at phone width.
[F2P][D9] Every decision control remains contained and mutually separated on a phone.
[F2P][D9] Live resize preserves alignment without document-level sideways overflow.
